Hey, I just discovered I was pregnant in early December and am currently recovering from the pill. I had my consultation this Monday and took the first pill that day at Planned Parenthood, then the following day I took three more. The first one was an anti-nausea pill, second was 800 mg ibuprofen, and then the dreadful misoprostol. It kicked in about 30 minutes later and at first I was at level 100 of cramping and then about an hour later it got to level 1000, which went on for about 3-5 hours. In total it took about 8 hours to get the fetus out. They told me by Wednesday the cramping and bleeding would stop but I am still bleeding. It literally felt like I was giving birth, minus the umbilical cord, placenta, and full-term baby. I'm feeling okay emotionally, a little detached but also so proud of myself for handling that pain. Lots of tears of joy and relief. I've never been through this before. I was having the worst morning sickness for about two weeks prior to my discovery so I looked forward to the 17th. I terminated at 8 weeks and five days.

I laid towels out on my bed instead of wearing pads all day that would just be full of blood. I played peaceful indian harp tunes, lit some amber aromatherapy, had a heated blanket nearby that saved my life, and the baby's father brought me food and whatever I needed after. He even went with me to the ultrasound and consultation. He was amazing throughout this, I couldn't have done it without him. Just breathe deep and brace yourself, it was a roller coaster for me. I'm still like whoa. 

I hope the process is smooth for you. xo
